title: Evaluation, testing, and operations
subtitle: Turn service requests about quality and reliability into repeatable evidence.
goal: Check the system before adding more complexity
intro: Evaluation means comparing observed behavior with an explicit expectation, not judging whether an answer sounds impressive.
terms: Cases not used to tune the system
case: A search change improves average scores but loses exception clauses.
Separate retrieval, answer support, and task outcome checks reveal the regression.
One overall score hides distinct failures.
